status: PILOT: all balance targets are provisional. Run the Stage A calibration (python balance.py calibrate ...), review the proposed intervals, then set status to FROZEN and bump experiment_config_version before the principal collection.

fixed.name: fixed_default
fixed.provenance: Canonical static configuration: neutral multipliers 1.0 (enemies use the documented base constants ENEMY_BASE_HP=30, ENEMY_BASE_DMG=6, ENEMY_SPEED=110) and spawn_count = DDA_SPAWN_BASE = 2, the documented base spawn count. A consistent historical static configuration for the current game could not be established: the ALPHA build (14bab89) used multipliers 1.0 with spawn_count 6 but different base stats (ENEMY_BASE_HP=42, ENEMY_BASE_DMG=9), and 301bf81 used ad-hoc test values (0.4/0.3/0.25/2). Not tuned on pilot outcomes.

shared_boss.description: Deterministic boss policy shared by every experimental condition. The raw action below passes through dda_core.effective_applied_config (hp x4, dmg x1.7, speed x0.9, one boss). No enemy model is invoked in boss rooms.

bot_selection.description: With the archetype's p_take_loot the bot picks one of the 3 offers uniformly at random, otherwise it takes nothing.

q_loot_gate.description: Learned loot is trained only if a reward-aware Q_loot beats its information-matched state-only twin (x+c vs x, x+c+item+prior vs x+prior) on held-out runs by a MEAN aggregate-skill gain >= min_reward_gain_rel with a positive gain on EVERY grouped split in split_seeds, and beats the naive predictor on every split.

cgan_training.description: Defaults for train_cgan.py (CLI flags override and are recorded). lambda_balance=1 let the adversarial term pull G back toward the observed action distribution during the smoke pilot.

calibration_rule.description: Pre-specified, controller-agnostic proposal rule: continuous targets = [q25, q75] of the POOLED pilot outcomes of all collection policies; death targets keep the design ceiling. The rule never looks at which controller performs best.

principal_collection.description: Documented collection mixtures (per-run assignment by seeded draw). learned_loot is never used during collection; it may be trained afterwards only if the predefined Q_loot gate passes on the principal data.
